label_unit: complete public request as one composite requirement; concrete help to any specified step, not whole-issue sufficiency
labels: two independent model_judged_text passes; disagreement UNKNOWN; literal quotes validated
pool: all five original registry packages, no outcome-based candidate filtering
fit: original eight rank training tasks plus two original rank-dev tasks
cal: original four gate-fit and two gate-calibration tasks
check: original four final tasks, now observed development check only
calibration: family-weighted regularized affine sigmoid; leave-one-family-out predictions for threshold selection, refit all cal
threshold_tie_break: maximum weighted recall, then precision, then higher threshold
no_operating_point: NO_VALID_OPERATING_POINT; do not lower target or fill K

execution.eligibility: already qualified installable snapshots with public requirements and trusted checks; selected before repair scores
execution.reason: bounded existing account allowance; prioritize support validation before Agent budget
